name: My True Desire
source:
In the world of My True Desire,  you follow the journey of a young man deeply in love, as he uncovers hidden desires he never knew he had.

Passion, fear, excitement, love, and anxiety. How will he navigate these overwhelming emotions?

And now that he’s allowing himself to explore these newfound feelings, how will his relationship with Ana, the love of his life, will evolve? Who will they become?

The game focuses on the main character's desires to show off and share his girlfriend, with a strong emphasis on the main character's perspective.

[From [url=https://dtz-games.itch.io/my-true-desire]Itch.io[/url]]
